notes.message: Brand primary (#F2E27A) is 1.32:1 against the page, below the 3:1 needed to see a control's edge. The brand fill is kept and controls get a #A59525 border (3.03:1).
White text on #F2E27A is only 1.32:1, so text on this colour is #171717 (13.60:1).
A separate primary text shade (#807001) is used for links and outline buttons so they stay at 4.96:1 on the surface.
Brand accent (#CFE8E0) is 1.29:1 against the page, below the 3:1 needed to see a control's edge. The brand fill is kept and controls get a #819891 border (3.07:1).
White text on #CFE8E0 is only 1.29:1, so text on this colour is #171717 (13.89:1).
A separate accent text shade (#5A736B) is used for links and outline buttons so they stay at 5.12:1 on the surface.
Dark-mode primary derived at lightness 82% so the fill keeps 3:1 against the dark surface.
Dark-mode accent derived at lightness 82% so the fill keeps 3:1 against the dark surface.
